title: Jealousy Signal Party
oneLiner: A flirt-heavy social game where people send risky little attraction signals, trigger jealousy meters, and unlock shared chemistry scenes without needing a full dating-app conversation.
targetUser: Singles who enjoy playful sexual tension, attention games, and screenshot-worthy social interactions more than serious profile browsing.
keyUX: Drop a bold signal, watch attraction and jealousy meters react, and unlock increasingly intimate scenes only when the energy stays mutual.
stitchPrompt: Design a bold desktop flirting game called Jealousy Signal Party for singles who enjoy playful sexual tension more than standard dating app profiles. It should let people send risky little attraction signals, watch chemistry and jealousy meters move in real time, and unlock more intimate shared scenes only when energy stays mutual. Include a chemistry and jealousy stage, a signal drop carousel, a mutual tension ladder, a private prompt unlock tray, an attention heatmap feed, and a shareable afterglow recap drawer. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with glossy dark surfaces, electric gradients, seductive neon cues, and one irresistibly escalating interaction path so the product feels provocative, stylish, and instantly screenshot-worthy.
